notes.title: MULTIPLAYER UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey Ducks

We have a huge surprise announcement today - so without further ado, here it is!

DUCK LIFE 8: ADVENTURE IS NOW AN MMO! 
…bet you didn’t see that coming!

Now you can experience your adventure alongside thousands of other players in our first ever massively multiplayer Duck Life game. We’ve also added in game chat so you can ask for help from other players, or just say hi! Want to play with your friends only? With the built-in custom server feature you can use a shared password to make your very own world away from everyone else
